audit_scope: MIT-base ancestry, 174 imported local-extension files, package/native license inventory, and the completed candidate changed/new text-source similarity screen. Dependency binaries and ownership remain outside the screen.

similarity_screen.method: Eight consecutive nonblank whitespace-normalized lines, minimum 200 characters, present in later upstream but absent from MIT tree. Similarity is a screening signal, not a legal originality finding.

license_decision.inherited_code: Retain MIT terms and upstream attribution from the historical base.
license_decision.original_extension_work: Maintainer authorized an MIT offer for original local extension work; preserve any identified third-party terms.
license_decision.new_port_work: Implement missing integration against the MIT base, with new tests and explicit provenance.
license_decision.later_upstream_material: No permission inferred to distribute later Apache-only material without its applicable conditions.
license_decision.copyright_notice: The e2e-cpp contributors label identifies original fork contributions collectively; it does not assign ownership or replace upstream attribution.

limitations: Git authorship, creation in a new path, and a similarity screen do not establish copyright ownership.
The screen does not detect all rewritten, transformed, short, or externally sourced material.
The screen is not a complete dependency SBOM, patent review, trademark authorization, or legal clearance.
The final archive must include only the intended Git ancestry and reviewed working tree, and actual binary distributions retain dependency obligations.

current_tree_spot_check.scope: Completed candidate source after implementation and documentation freeze on 2026-10-24; 496 existing changed/new text source files were screened against the historical MIT and later upstream trees. Final validation-count prose may be added separately.
current_tree_spot_check.screen_result: Thirteen matching windows in five files required manual inspection. They consist of MIT-era context made contiguous with small directory, dependency-version or interface edits.

reviewed_matches.finding: Five windows differ from the inherited MIT prose only in the Vitest 4-to-5 version correction; four windows differ only in the packages-to-apps testbed relocation.
An independently added settleAttempt interface key precedes unchanged MIT lifecycle keys and comments.
A new closing brace precedes the unchanged MIT artifact comment and measurement code.
The added method terminator precedes the unchanged MIT endAttempt method and its comment.
The existing MIT app.open navigation branch is now a conditional-expression branch; the subsequent MIT navigation methods are unchanged.

current_tree_spot_check.conclusion: The reviewed matches do not identify substantive copying of a later upstream implementation. This is a technical similarity screen, not proof of independent authorship or legal clearance.
current_tree_spot_check.implementation_attestation: Core and security porters report implementing against MIT checkout files without opening/copying later upstream core implementations in this task. This is not described as a clean-room process.

code_fingerprint.scope: Changed/new implementation, tests and source configuration; documentation is excluded from this fingerprint.
